success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant cancels reservation RSV-4471 via cancel_reservation and confirms the cancellation to the user based on the tool result. The assistant may first look the reservation up with get_reservation_status; it must not claim the cancellation succeeded without a successful tool result.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Midway through the conversation, change one previously stated slot value exactly once and ask the assistant to redo the work with the new value.

<action type="say">
I’m not able to redo or edit a cancellation once it’s been successfully processed in this system, so I can’t update the stored reason from “plans changed” to “traveling out of town.”

If you’d like, I can help you find the restaurant’s phone number or help you make a new reservation for another date.</action>
